dogecoin.text:
I forgot to mark my 4-year anniversary in crypto!  

Bought my first bit of $BTC on February 12, 2014.  Got $DOGE with it after reading a paid article on Yahoo Finance, I think.

Didn't do much with it, only really got into crypto in April 2014 with $BLK (see previous tweets).

@loomdart Very similar story - read about Dogecoin somewhere in February 2014, decided that was my tipping point to finally learn how to buy BTC for the first time... So I could buy DOGE near the top. 

I'm still an idiot too frequently, but I've learned a few things in these 4 years.
